back: Male, female, young rabbit; kindling = giving birth.
Meat: New Zealand White, Californian, Flemish Giant. Fur: Chinchilla, Rex. Wool: Angora.
Gestation about 31 days; nest box about day 27; eyes open about day 10; wean at 6-8 weeks.
Rabbits have no regular heat cycle; mating triggers ovulation.

front: Why the doe goes to the buck
back: Does defend their own hutch and may attack a buck placed there.
Rabbits eat soft night droppings from the caecum, rich in microbial protein and B vitamins.
Raised legs, wire or slatted floor, overhanging sloping roof, mesh front, one adult per compartment, predator-proof.
Remove cased, scrape fat and flesh, stretch flesh-side out, dry in the shade, store dry.
